statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); ∀ X : ℕ, 9 ≤ X → let Q := ((Finset.range (Nat.sqrt (2*X+2)+1)).filter Nat.Prime).prod id; ((w X).filter (fun n => Nat.Coprime n Q ∧ Nat.Coprime (n+2) Q)) = ((w X).filter (fun n => n.Prime ∧ (n+2).Prime))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 指定平移的 Θ 提升 · TP-0048 · 在平方根筛界准确识别真正的差二相关
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta lift for a prescribed shift · TP-0048 · Identify the exact two-prime correlation at the square-root sieve cutoff

brief.zh: 合数有不大于平方根的素因子；窗中两端都超过筛界。可用作指定局部测试的精确算术参照。
brief.en: A composite has a prime divisor up to its square root. Both endpoints exceed the sieve cutoff. This gives an exact arithmetic test for the prescribed local data.
